Fictional ME/CFS Biobank

The Fictional ME/CFS Biobank is operated by the Imaginary Institute of Medicine in Freedonia.

It holds blood samples and questionnaire data from people with ME/CFS diagnosed under the Canadian Consensus Criteria.

Researchers outside the Imaginary Institute can obtain access to the data by “registering an account” on the portal.

Open download of summary tables is possible without an account.
